stories.title: Residents with communal heating will save up to 63% on bills from August
stories.summary: Residents with communal heating for their properties in Flintshire will see their bills fall by up to 63% from August. stories.title: Nursing union urges Welsh Government to publish corridor care data
stories.summary: The Royal College of Nursing in Wales is calling on the Welsh Government to publish monthly corridor care figures for every health board, after England’s first national data was released. Corridor care refers to patients being treated in corridors, chairs and other spaces not designed for clinical care because of pressure on hospitals. RCN Wales

stories.title: Search and rescue volunteers called out four times in two days across north east Wales
stories.summary: Volunteers from North East Wales Search and Rescue were called out four times in two days this week, helping the ambulance service reach patients in difficult locations. stories.title: Connah’s Quay Salvation Army marks 135 years with weekend of celebrations
stories.summary: The Salvation Army’s leaders for the UK and Ireland are returning to Connah’s Quay this weekend, where they once led the town’s church, to mark its 135th anniversary. Commissioners Jenine and Paul Main led the Connah’s Quay church for four years between 1988 and 1992, and both of their children were born during that time.
